title: Insect-Inspired P1/P2 data schema
description: README v1.1 field schema. Validate an entity using its $defs entry; cross-entity invariants are recorded in x-semantic-rules and executable local audit. Core enumerations are closed.

x-semantic-rules.description: Each effective Work has >=1 Version; each Version has one valid Work; each admitted Upload has one Version and matching Work; duplicate pointers are acyclic.
Seed S01/S15, S02/S17, S19/S20 preserve fixed inverse independent Work relationships; no seed added or merged.

Reported conditions require typed nonnull value and locator; not_reported requires a completed relevant fulltext check; unknown requires a task and original timestamp; >24h un-escalated unknown invalid.
Unknown/null nested fields require field_states; numeric values finite, QuantityRange min<=max, physically compatible units, none scale prior exclusive.
No nonseed parsing without continuous verified authorized scope-bound discovery path rooted in admitted Seed/Work.
Automatic cascade is atomic; equivalent Assessments merge with history, unsupported discard with reason, independent counter-evidence preserved, conflicts go pending_review.
Claim-level quantitative/rigorous-derivation and trajectory/metric-scale gates; no unsupported absolute-scale eligibility.
K equals U union all T, U is K minus all T; 10 tables; active Assessment CSV sets and all export IDs reconcile.
Deterministic outputs; paginated tasks preserve cursors/errors on interruption; checkpoint valid only when all applicable integrity gates pass.
Assessment species/motion_type/environment/scale equal projections of conditions. Dataset/baseline/metric/condition foreign keys and all other core IDs resolve.

query_time_precision.queried_at_utc: Exact UTC request timestamp when available; never replaced by the later audit timestamp.
query_time_precision.recorded_at_utc: Actual UTC time the observation was logged. Required when request timestamp is unavailable.
query_time_precision.queried_date: Calendar date established from actual retrieval context. Required with unavailable_exact.
query_time_precision.unavailable_exact_rule: queried_at_utc=null, status=partial and verification_status=source_supported. The record cannot prove exact-time coverage; underlying identity confirmation may use separate exact API records.

institution_api_fields.AFF: Europe PMC affiliation query field; exact provider syntax, distinct from scientific classification.
institution_api_fields.FIRST_PDATE: Europe PMC first publication date query field; day precision and index gaps are disclosed in scope.
institution_api_fields.evidence: TITLE_ABS/AFF have documented known-positive/negative seed probes. FIRST_PDATE is admitted as an official syntax field; capability proof requires separate logged positive/negative date-filter tests. Institution-wide search remains pending P5.

entity_relation_role.role: Optional closed role classification: authorship, byline_affiliation_at_publication, present_address_at_publication.
entity_relation_role.work_id: Optional canonical Work foreign key for the publication observation; required by semantic validation when role identifies publication affiliation or present address.
entity_relation_role.temporal_rule: Publication observation date is not an employment start or end date. Unstated employment intervals remain null with state evidence.
entity_relation_role.editors_rule: Work.editors points to Person records; a book editor is not automatically an author of its individual chapter.
